content.thinking:
I'm drafting a paragraph that keeps out any figures and uses the {duration} and {customer_loss} placeholders. No on-call incident was linked and nobody was paged, so responders bore no cost, and I'm steering clear of "brief" and of saying "all shoppers." The affected group is shoppers visiting their account pages, since the cause was slow loading of those pages.

I'm dropping the figure-like identifier and describing the fix as a draft pull request instead. Argus rolled the deployment back, which is confirmed and still in place, and automatic sync stays off. The customer loss estimate is Argus's, and the pages stayed correct.

input.overview: For {duration}, shoppers on io-shop found that their account pages loaded slowly. A configuration change pointed the account pages at an address where their cache could not be reached, so each page had to work out its figures from scratch. The pages still showed the right information, but they took longer to appear. Argus estimates the lost takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus ended the slowdown by rolling back the io-shop deployment. The rollback is confirmed and still in place, and automatic sync has been left off. Argus has also proposed a lasting fix as a draft pull request. It has not been approved or applied yet.
